comments.author: @thenoblerot
comments.text:
A few points that stood out to me in the OpenAI notes:

- Fine-tuning can start with as few as 10 examples, with 50-100 recommended. That is a huge reduction over the 200+ recommended for fine tuning davinci and the other older models.

- A gpt-3.5-turbo model can perform as well as or better than gpt-4 for specific cases.

- Can't resume a tuning session. When fine-tuning the older models you are able to incrementally tune your existing fine-tuned models.

- no function cal tuning yet, as Wes mentioned

I'm very excited! I think I may have a project perfect for a 10 to 50 example tuning!
